requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4054-6006--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4054-6006--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Primeval Bounty triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki

2105-3337-5607.easyPrerequisites: Reflection of Kiki-Jiki does not have summoning sickness.
2105-3337-5607.notablePrerequisites: Klauth can attack without taking damage.
2105-3337-5607.description:
Activate Reflection of KIki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant with haste.
Declare Klauth and Combat Celebrant token as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
When you attack, Klauth and the Combat Celebrant token trigger.
Resolve the token's trigger, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve Klauth's trigger, adding mana.
Repeat.

requires.battlefieldCardState: without a finality counter on it

3899-4053-7134--145.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a Villain without a finality counter on it.
When the Villain dies, Thunderbolts Conspiracy triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

728-1329-2178-3661.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
728-1329-2178-3661.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
When Shield Sphere dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

222-527-1322-3899.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-1322-3899.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

618-728-4142.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Hostage Taker.
When the Hostage Taker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the Hostage Taker token.
When the Hostage Taker token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-6719-6797.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-6719-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2292-4153--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2292-4153--5--195.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Resourceful Defense trigger.
Resolve Resourceful Defense's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Repeat.

851-2557-3129-6664-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

3234-3946-3967-7776.description:
While Glacial Chasm is on the battlefield, all damage that would be dealt to you is prevented.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Glacial Chasm triggers. Choose not to pay its cumulative upkeep cost and sacrifice it.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, its second ability triggers, returning Glacial Chasm and Mortuary Mire from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Glacial Chasm and Mortuary Mire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Glacial Chasm trigger, sacrificing Mortuary Mire.
Resolve the Mortuary Mire trigger, putting World Shaper from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 3.
Move to your next turn, drawing World Shaper during your draw step.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Glacial Chasm triggers. Choose not to pay its cumulative upkeep cost and sacrifice it.
Cast World Shaper by paying {3}{G}.
Repeat from step 3.
3234-3946-3967-7776.notes: If your life total allows, you can instead opt to pay Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep cost. If you do this, you can forego doing this loop during that turn.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

624-670-1619-7193.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
624-670-1619-7193.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Omni-Changeling and Phantasmal Image each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Omni-Changeling trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Phantasmal Image trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
624-670-1619-7193.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

3614-5016-7711.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Red Hulk.
3614-5016-7711.description:
Give Red Hulk and Spitemare indestructible using Heroic Intervention.
Deal damage to Red Hulk.
Red Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and dealing damage to Spitemare.
Spitemare triggers, dealing damage to Red Hulk.
Repeat from step 3.
3614-5016-7711.notes: The final instance of damage can be flung at an opponent for infinite damage. If you can deal more damage to Red Hulk afterwards, you can deal infinite damage to more targets.

1947-2523-2869.description:
Activate Reckless Barbarian by sacrificing it.
When Reckless Barbarian dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Reckless Barbarian that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat using the Reckless Barbarian token

457-1409-3847-7306.description:
Activate Arcbound Worker by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Arcbound Worker leaves and reenters the battlefield, causing it to enter with a +1/+1 counter due to its modular ability, and triggering The Ooze and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve Deadeye Navigator's trigger, repairing it and Arcbound Worker
Resolve The Ooze's trigger, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter that was on Arcbound Worker when it left the battlefield.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping Arcbound Worker and a Mutagen, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

141-1796-7301.description:
Cast Avatar's Wrath by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost reduced by Centaur Omenreader.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Avatar's Wrath targeting Centaur Omenreader
Resolve Avatar's Wrath, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {0} due to Centaur Omenreader.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

4091-5921-5970-6791.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Aphetto Alchemist.
Activate one of the Aphetto Alchemist tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Aphetto Alchemist token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

622-851-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
622-851-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Kamahl
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-2557-3088-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Xenic Poltergeist.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

486-1355-1978.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three enchantments.
486-1355-1978.description:
Cause Sanctum Weaver to become an artifact using Liquimetal Torque.
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Sanctum Weaver.
Repeat from step 2.

attached to Siren of the Silent Song

1557-3525-5268.description:
Activate Siren of the Silent Song by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Siren of the Silent Song.
Siren of the Silent Song triggers, causing each opponent to discard a card and mill a card.
Repeat.

2178-3817-6542-6797.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with mana value 5.
2178-3817-6542-6797.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken creature with mana value 5.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the creature with mana value 5 from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

67-2292-2781.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Reveillark.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Reveillark.
When Reveillark leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian and up to one other creature with power 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1939-2919-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1939-2919-4186.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Lunarch Veteran triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickess and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent

813-5775-6103-6492.notablePrerequisites: Fortune does not have summoning sickness. An opponent cannot block and kill Fortune.
813-5775-6103-6492.description:
Cast Illusion of Choice by paying {U}, allowing you to decide how each player votes this turn and causing you to draw a a card.
Cast Plea for Power by paying {3}{U}, choosing all votes to be for time, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Fortune's saddle ability by tapping Scholar of the Ages, causing Fortune to become saddled until end of turn.
Declare Fortune as an attacker, triggering Fortune's ability.
At the end of your combat phase, Fortune triggers, blinking it and Scholar of the Ages.
When Fortune and Scholar of the Ages enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Fortune trigger, causing you to scry 2.
Resolve the Scholar of the Ages trigger, returning Illusion of Choice and Plea for Power from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2720-2770-4691.description:
Cast Donate by paying {2}{U}, giving an opponent control of Vilis.
During that player's next draw step, they draw a card.
Underworld Dreams triggers, dealing 1 damage to that opponent.
Vilis triggers, causing the opponent to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3.
